# Permanent Revolutionary Congress (PRC)

> A revolutionary socialist organization based in Kenya, organizing workers, youth, women and the oppressed for socialist transformation. Affiliated to the International Socialist League.

PRC fights for workers' power, socialist democracy, anti-imperialism, women's liberation, climate justice and permanent revolution.
